## Installed
== Install Homebrew Applications
link    Install homebrew apps = Browse -> Open <apps>
== Uninstall Applications
action  Homebrew Channel = 2.3 MB -> Uninstall (confirms) <apps>
action  Dev Manager = 7.0 MB -> Uninstall (confirms) <apps>
action  Media Center = 89.6 MB -> Uninstall (confirms) <apps>
## Home screen
== Home screen layout
toggle  HDMI 1 = On Home [on] -> Turn off <hdmi>
toggle  HDMI 2 = Not on Home [off] -> Turn on <hdmi>
toggle  Promotions = Hidden [off] -> Turn on <apps>
toggle  Banner = Shown [on] -> Turn off <apps>
action  Put back LG’s Home screen = Put back -> Put back (confirms) <refresh>
## Quick Access
info    1 = HDMI 1 <apps>
info    2 = Nothing set <apps>
## System apps
== Hide Home Screen System Apps
toggle  System App Hiding = Enabled [on] -> Turn off <apps>
toggle  Live TV = Hidden [off] -> Turn on <apps>
toggle  Music = Visible [on] -> Turn off <apps>
## Kept ready
== Apps kept ready in the background
toggle  LG Discover = Kept ready [on] -> Turn off <apps>
toggle  Web Browser = Switched off [off] -> Turn on <apps>
## Services
== Turn Off Background Services
toggle  Content recognition = Active [on] -> Turn off <shield>
